_comment: Phase-3 STATIC data xrefs: which instructions read/write each OWNED semantic address. Resolves gp-relative and lui-formed absolute accesses. Accesses through a RUNTIME POINTER cannot be resolved statically and are counted separately — an entry with no static xref is 'not statically referenced', which is NOT the same as 'nothing touches it'. Hand-declared writers are VERIFIED here; ones this scan cannot see are reported as contradictions rather than dropped. Regenerate: python3 tools/phase3_xrefs.py

mod_private_not_verifiable_against_prist.why: mod_private state is written by MOD CAVE code, which does not exist in the pristine image — not verifiable here, and not a contradiction.

declared_writers_via_pointer_unverifiabl.why: the named function writes this state through a POINTER (cursor/base register), which a static absolute-address scan cannot attribute. NOT a contradiction — a limit of the method, stated rather than hidden.
